### Task
Clear summary of the technical or operational deliverable.

### Objective
What technical milestone or architectural goal is achieved upon completion?

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Requirement 1 defined and validated.
- [ ] Requirement 2 defined and validated.
- [ ] Unit/Integration tests passing.

### Definition of Done
- [ ] Code implemented and peer-reviewed.
- [ ] Git branch complies with naming conventions (`feature/*`, `bugfix/*`).
- [ ] CI pipeline passes with green build status.
- [ ] Documentation updated in README or architecture logs.
